description: Start a planned import (status 'scanned') — what «Start» on the Import tab does: the plan is checked again against the site and the company, and a refusal names what stands in the way. 'workflow': 'jira' gives the new project Jira's own statuses; 'workspace' uses the company's usual workflow, with 'statuses' saying where each Jira status goes (an import into a project that exists always uses its workflow). 'types' says where a Jira issue type goes, where the plan's suggestion is not wanted. 'people' says who each Jira account is here — a username of the company, or nothing after '=' for «nobody, keep the name in the text»; an account left out stays as the plan matched it, and a matching the company saved earlier is kept. 'acceptUnits' must be true when get_import's plan says units.over. Answers with the import, now 'queued'; get_import shows its progress and, when done, its report. The company's administrator only.

acceptUnits.description: True once the unit figure in the plan was seen and the import may take the company past its allowance.

people.description: Jira account → username here, as 'acc-1=anna, 557058:abc=' — nothing after '=' is «nobody».

statuses.description: For 'workspace': where each Jira status goes, as 'To Do=Backlog, In QA=In Review'.

types.description: Where each Jira issue type goes, as 'Баг=Bug, Investigate=Task' — a type of get_import's plan.targetTypes; a type left out goes where plan.types[].mapsTo suggests.

name: start_import
title: Start import
